figurative_meaning_en: The united power of the common people
example_sentences_in_bangla: গণশক্তির মাধ্যমে আমরা অন্যায়ের বিরুদ্ধে লড়াই করব।
স্বাধীনতা আন্দোলনে গণশক্তি অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা পালন করেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: We will fight against injustice through the power of the people.
People's power played a crucial role in the independence movement.
history: This term gained prominence during India's independence movement and leftist uprisings in Bengal, emphasizing collective action against colonial and oppressive forces.
note: More of a socio-political term than a traditional proverb, but used idiomatically in discourse on democracy and resistance.
